batch_node.name: rampart-20x-playground inventory software v0.1.0
batch_node.description: The software the git-serious web image carries, as values read from the running web container on 2026-10-14 (os-release; the apk database; uv.lock; the js-vendor package-lock.json; the crypto-BOM scan, scope tap-web) and from the repository (the pinned wolfi-base digest in the Dockerfile; docker/sbom-supplemental.json). Hand-seeded, so every entity carries dcom=design (req-rampart-20x-playground-inventory-software). Not an SBOM: package rows name their real source in source_document, and a generated SBOM replaces that source later. The container host is not stamped overview, so it stays off the Overview board. No key material, fingerprint or file content is recorded.
